properties.name: rest-http-client.request-factory-override
properties.description: What to do when a RestClientCustomizer or RestTemplateBuilder customizer replaces the request factory of an @RestHttpClient client, which would drop its connection pool, timeouts and SSL.

properties.name: rest-http-client.auto-scan.enabled
properties.description: Whether the @RestHttpClient interfaces of the application packages are registered automatically (it is skipped anyway when @EnableRestHttpClients is used).

values.description: Accept only test doubles such as MockRestServiceServer; ignore any other replacement and log a warning.
Accept any replacement, logging a warning when it is not a test double.
Never accept a replacement, not even a test double.
